game.rules:
****Translated rules: https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vSrEKDAQXiokgEU1On58YNJCfdhQOD1FAETvKpyIhPlQLmezZxaxFR1GtpLpMyqC0X90PQ4L0ZTSdzd/pub**
**(English, 日本語, Deutsch, Français, Español, Italiano, Português)****

**PLEASE NOTE THAT RUNS THAT ARE FASTER THAN THE PROOF THRESHOLDS MUST HAVE VIDEO PROOF. YOU CAN FIND THOSE THRESHOLDS IN THE LINKED DOCUMENT ABOVE**

### Platform Rules

- Emulators are banned.
- Mods or hacks of any kind are banned.
- Modifications to the Switch that give unfair advantages are banned.

### Timing

- Timing begins upon pressing the big yellow button ("OK" in most languages) to start the first race.
- Timing ends upon crossing the finish line of the final track.
- Submit your RTA time in the “Time” field. **Leave “In-game Time” blank!**
- Cup runs must begin on the first track of the cup (i.e., you may not submit cup runs done in the middle of a longer run).
- 16 Tracks or 48 Tracks runs done within a larger run may be submitted. In this case, timing begins upon crossing the finish line of the final track before the category and ends as normal. For example, a Bonus Tracks run contained within a 48 Tracks run would start upon crossing the finish line of N64 Rainbow Road and end upon crossing the finish line of Big Blue.

### VS Race Rules

- Some rules vary between categories, but these rules are always consistent:
- Teams: No Teams
- COM: Any COM for No Items Runs, Hard COM for Items Runs *(Implemented Nov. 13, 2023)*
- COM Vehicles: All Vehicles
- Cup items runs may be done in Grand Prix mode rather than VS mode.

### Proof

- All submissions for 48, 32, and 16-track categories faster than the following threshold times (see below) must include video proof. The first time is the threshold for runs on the digital version; the time in parentheses is the threshold for the cartridge version, which loads more slowly. (Implemented 8/15/20)
- *NOTE: The minimap must be clearly visible (not covered by splits or other visuals) to qualify as adequate video proof.*
- If a Twitch video is used, it must be a HIGHLIGHT, NOT a vod. Twitch automatically deletes stream vods after two weeks.
- **Run videos MUST show the VS race settings** (not applicable for cup items runs done in Grand Prix mode).
- Proof thresholds (runs faster than these times require video proof): https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vSrEKDAQXiokgEU1On58YNJCfdhQOD1FAETvKpyIhPlQLmezZxaxFR1GtpLpMyqC0X90PQ4L0ZTSdzd/pub (at the end of the document)
- For all Cup categories, times within 10s of the world record (RTA) require video proof.
- Handheld and camera recordings are acceptable.

### Other Rules

- Only single-player speedruns are allowed.
- Auto-Accelerate is allowed.
- Smart Steering is allowed, although using it for full runs is discouraged.
- Again, submit your RTA time in the “Time” field. **Leave “In-game Time” blank!**
- If your video proof features multiple attempts or runs, please leave timestamps for the start and end of your run. If we have to spend time trying to find out where your actual run is, we may reject it and ask you to resubmit

relatedGames.name: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe Category Extensions
relatedGames.rules:
**Platform Rules**

- Emulators are banned.
- Game mods or hacks of any kind are banned.
- Modifications to the Switch that give unfair advantages are also banned.

**Default Proof Requirements**

- The top 5 runs in a category require video proof. 
- If specified, individual category's proof requirements override this (e.g., all 100% runs require proof).
- Capture card footage is preferred, but phone and camera recordings are also acceptable proof.

**Other Rules**

- Auto-Accelerate is allowed.
- Smart Steering is allowed, although using it for entire runs is discouraged.

categories.name: DLC Cups
categories.rules:
### Category Rules

- Complete the 4 tracks in a given cup in order.
- You cannot submit DLC cups within a larger run. Your run must be able to follow the rules detailed in the "Timing" section.
- No Items runs must be done in VS mode. Items runs can be done in VS mode or Grand Prix mode.

### Timing

- Timing starts when you press "OK" after selecting the first track of the cup.
- Timing ends at the finish line of the last track of the cup.

- Class: (See Below)
- Teams: No Teams 
- Items: (See Below)
- COM: Hard COM
- COM Vehicles: All Vehicles
- Courses: In Order
- Race Count: 4 Races (or higher if part of a larger run)

categories.name: 48 Tracks
categories.rules:
### Category Rules

- Complete the original 48 tracks.
- As of 6/18/22, you must start on Mario Kart Stadium.
- Runs must be done in VS mode.

### Timing

- Timing starts when you press "OK" after selecting the first track.
- Timing ends at the finish line of the last track.

### VS Race Settings

- Class: (See Below)
- Teams: No Teams 
- Items: (See Below)
- COM: Any COM for No Items, Hard COM for Items
- COM Vehicles: All Vehicles
- Courses: In Order
- Race Count: 48 Races

categories.name: 48 Tracks (DLC)
categories.rules:
### Category Rules

- Complete all 48 tracks in the Booster Course Pass.
- Runs must be started on Tour Paris Promenade.
- Runs must be done in VS mode.

### Timing

- Timing starts when you press "OK" after selecting Tour Paris Promenade.
- Timing ends at the finish line of Wii Rainbow Road.

### VS Race Settings

- Class: (See Below)
- Teams: No Teams 
- Items: (See Below)
- COM: Any COM for No Items, Hard COM for Items
- COM Vehicles: All Vehicles
- Courses: In Order
- Race Count: 48 Races

categories.name: 96 Tracks
categories.rules:
### Category Rules

- Complete all 96 tracks (Base Game + Booster Course Pass)
- Runs can start on any track
- Runs must be done in VS mode.
- Changing combo between the two 48 track sections is allowed, but note that menuing time is included in the run.

### Timing

- Timing starts when you press "OK" after selecting the first track in the first 48 track run
- Timing ends at the finish line of the last track in the second 48 track run.

### VS Race Settings

- Class: (See Below)
- Teams: No Teams 
- Items: (See Below)
- COM: Any COM for No Items, Hard COM for Items
- COM Vehicles: All Vehicles
- Courses: In Order
- Race Count: 48 Races (Two consecutive runs to play all 96 Tracks)

### **NOTE: If submitting a run with a break, you MUST include a timestamp of the break in the run description, and the break MUST adhere to the following rules:**

- **The break can last for a maximum of 15 minutes.**
- **You have two options for how you can take a break:**

1. By pressing the Home Screen Button. This can be done at any moment after you cross the finish line on a race but before Lakitu starts counting down on the next race. **The pause starts when you press the home button and ends when you open the game again.**
2. By leaving the game idle when it is waiting for a button press to proceed. This means the pause can only start once you get to the screen that shows "Next Race" or "View Results". If you are taking a break in between two 48-track segments, then you can leave the game idle at various other places before you start the next 48 segment, such as the VS Race rules or the OK screen when selecting the first track. **The key is that you can only stop the timer when the game is waiting for a button press to proceed.**

values.name: Breaks
values.rules:
If submitting a run with breaks, they MUST adhere to the following rules.

You have two options for how you can take a break:

1. By pressing the Home Screen Button. This can be done at any moment after you cross the finish line on a race but before Lakitu starts counting down on the next race. **The pause starts when you press the home button and ends when you open the game again.**
2. By leaving the game idle in between races. **The pause starts when the game is in a state that it is waiting for a button press to proceed and ends when you press any button**. This means that you can't start your pause immediately after crossing the finish line, and the pause can only start once you get to the screen that shows "Next Race" or "View Results". If you are taking a break in between two 48-track segments, then you can leave the game idle at various other places before you start the next 48 segment, such as the OK screen when selecting the first track. **The key is that you can only stop the timer when the game is waiting for a button press to proceed.**

### Category Rules

- Complete the 4 tracks in the given cup in order.
- You may not submit Cup speedruns that were done in the *middle* of a larger run (e.g., submitting Mushroom Cup from a Nitro Tracks run is allowed, but submitting Flower/Star/Special Cups is not). Your run must be able to follow the rules detailed in the "Timing" section.
- No Items runs must be done in VS mode. Items runs can be done in VS mode or Grand Prix mode.

### Timing

- Timing starts when you press "OK" after selecting the first track of the cup.
- Timing ends upon crossing the finish line of the last track of the cup.

### VS Race Settings

Note: If you are doing an Items run in Grand Prix mode, you do not need to worry about any settings.

- Class: (See Below)
- Teams: No Teams 
- Items: (See Below)
- COM: Any COM for No Items, Hard COM for Items (Not applicable in Grand Prix Mode)
- COM Vehicles: All Vehicles
- Courses: In Order
- Race Count: 4 Races (or higher if the first cup of a larger run)

games.name: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe
games.rules:
****Translated rules: https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vSrEKDAQXiokgEU1On58YNJCfdhQOD1FAETvKpyIhPlQLmezZxaxFR1GtpLpMyqC0X90PQ4L0ZTSdzd/pub**
**(English, 日本語, Deutsch, Français, Español, Italiano, Português)****

**PLEASE NOTE THAT RUNS THAT ARE FASTER THAN THE PROOF THRESHOLDS MUST HAVE VIDEO PROOF. YOU CAN FIND THOSE THRESHOLDS IN THE LINKED DOCUMENT ABOVE**

### Platform Rules

- Emulators are banned.
- Mods or hacks of any kind are banned.
- Modifications to the Switch that give unfair advantages are banned.

### Timing

- Timing begins upon pressing the big yellow button ("OK" in most languages) to start the first race.
- Timing ends upon crossing the finish line of the final track.
- Submit your RTA time in the “Time” field. **Leave “In-game Time” blank!**
- Cup runs must begin on the first track of the cup (i.e., you may not submit cup runs done in the middle of a longer run).
- 16 Tracks or 48 Tracks runs done within a larger run may be submitted. In this case, timing begins upon crossing the finish line of the final track before the category and ends as normal. For example, a Bonus Tracks run contained within a 48 Tracks run would start upon crossing the finish line of N64 Rainbow Road and end upon crossing the finish line of Big Blue.

### VS Race Rules

- Some rules vary between categories, but these rules are always consistent:
- Teams: No Teams
- COM: Any COM for No Items Runs, Hard COM for Items Runs *(Implemented Nov. 13, 2023)*
- COM Vehicles: All Vehicles
- Cup items runs may be done in Grand Prix mode rather than VS mode.

### Proof

- All submissions for 48, 32, and 16-track categories faster than the following threshold times (see below) must include video proof. The first time is the threshold for runs on the digital version; the time in parentheses is the threshold for the cartridge version, which loads more slowly. (Implemented 8/15/20)
- *NOTE: The minimap must be clearly visible (not covered by splits or other visuals) to qualify as adequate video proof.*
- If a Twitch video is used, it must be a HIGHLIGHT, NOT a vod. Twitch automatically deletes stream vods after two weeks.
- **Run videos MUST show the VS race settings** (not applicable for cup items runs done in Grand Prix mode).
- Proof thresholds (runs faster than these times require video proof): https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vSrEKDAQXiokgEU1On58YNJCfdhQOD1FAETvKpyIhPlQLmezZxaxFR1GtpLpMyqC0X90PQ4L0ZTSdzd/pub (at the end of the document)
- For all Cup categories, times within 10s of the world record (RTA) require video proof.
- Handheld and camera recordings are acceptable.

### Other Rules

- Only single-player speedruns are allowed.
- Auto-Accelerate is allowed.
- Smart Steering is allowed, although using it for full runs is discouraged.
- Again, submit your RTA time in the “Time” field. **Leave “In-game Time” blank!**
- If your video proof features multiple attempts or runs, please leave timestamps for the start and end of your run. If we have to spend time trying to find out where your actual run is, we may reject it and ask you to resubmit

values.name: Breaks
values.rules:
If submitting a run with breaks, they MUST adhere to the following rules.

You have two options for how you can take a break:

1. By pressing the Home Screen Button. This can be done at any moment after you cross the finish line on a race but before Lakitu starts counting down on the next race. **The pause starts when you press the home button and ends when you open the game again.**
2. By leaving the game idle in between races. **The pause starts when the game is in a state that it is waiting for a button press to proceed and ends when you press any button**. This means that you can't start your pause immediately after crossing the finish line, and the pause can only start once you get to the screen that shows "Next Race" or "View Results". If you are taking a break in between two 48-track segments, then you can leave the game idle at various other places before you start the next 48 segment, such as the OK screen when selecting the first track. **The key is that you can only stop the timer when the game is waiting for a button press to proceed.**
